reported_quantity: % of shared hyperlinks in far-right chat-app messages whose domain was classified as Junk News and Disinformation
denominator: All hyperlink shares in socio-environmental messages collected from 467 far-right WhatsApp groups and 136 Telegram groups/channels in Brazil (26,152 links from 2226 domains extracted; 1015 domains shared >10 times, amounting to 24,179 links, were manually categorised)
misinfo_definition: "Websites classified as junk news (Howard, 2020), carrying a hyperpartisan, mostly right-wing bias... This classification is based on their frequent dissemination of misleading narratives, conspiracy theories, or highly distorted information"

reported_quantity: % of practitioners reporting they 'often' or 'sometimes' encountered patient misinformation about COVID-19 treatment
denominator: 2,108 practitioners answering the COVID-19-treatment misinformation frequency item
misinfo_definition: 'information that is factually inaccurate or not supported by current evidence-based medical literature and/or practices'

reported_quantity: % of PAE-related consumer YouTube videos containing potentially misinformative, inaccurate, or non-evidence-based claims about PAE
denominator: 31 unique English-language consumer YouTube videos with at least 100 views about prostate artery embolization, from the first 20 results of each of 21 PAE-specific YouTube queries (420 results; 371 duplicates, 15 clinician-targeted videos and 3 low-view videos excluded)
misinfo_definition: 'potentially misinformative, inaccurate, or non-evidence-based claims about PAE'

reported_quantity: % of respondents in latent class 1 who report having ever shared a political news story online that they thought at the time was made up (intentional sharing)
denominator: 96 Polish active Facebook news users in latent class 1 ("The oldest users with low SM literacy"); total sample 1,000 recruited from the largest Polish research panel
misinfo_definition: "For the purpose of this study, fake news is understood as partially or completely false information, intended to mislead the recipient, which may be intentionally and unintentionally disseminated by online news consumers"

reported_quantity: % of respondents who say they came across information in the last month that they knew or learned was fake news
denominator: 829 UK respondents completing both panel waves (n = 733 in the regression models)
misinfo_definition: "fake news" defined for respondents as "news that was produced in order to give false information"

reported_quantity: % of survey respondents who had come across a news item they immediately identified as fake
denominator: 309 UK internet users who completed an online survey (advertised via an online survey tool and snowballed from institutional mailing lists; 70.4% aged 18-25, 71% students)
misinfo_definition: the questions asked for instances where respondents had had cause to reflect on the 'truth' of a story, in line with Rubin's typology of 'humorous fakes in the form of news satire; large scale hoaxes ... and serious fabrication'

reported_quantity: % of expert-reviewed candidate posts judged to be discussing a new myth about medications for opioid use disorder
denominator: 800 social media posts (200 per platform) shortlisted by k-nearest-neighbour similarity to 3 seed MOUD myths from 19,953,599 opioid-related posts on Twitter, YouTube, Reddit and Drugs-Forum
misinfo_definition: "Health misinformation and myths about treatment for opioid use disorder (OUD)"; posts "that represent inaccurate or harmful information"

reported_quantity: % of respondents who report frequently coming across fake news stories in the past 6 months
denominator: 1,111 Chinese adults in a national online panel survey (Impression Boguan Network Technology / Sina Data Solution panel; cooperation rate 40.5%)
misinfo_definition: 'In this study, we define “fake news” as “news stories that are completely made up.”'

reported_quantity: % of Apple Siri responses to HPV vaccine queries containing at least one instance of misinformation
denominator: 36 analysable Siri responses (Siri provided five text results per query)
misinfo_definition: We defined misinformation as either deliberate or accidental promotion of previously disproved or unproven beliefs, attitudes, and behaviors.

reported_quantity: % of pelvic organ prolapse Pinterest pins containing any misinformation relative to IUGA/ICS guidelines
denominator: 100 relevant pelvic organ prolapse pins, the first 100 relevant results of a Pinterest search for 'pelvic organ prolapse' (search returned more than 300 results; duplicate-link, non-linking, paywalled, unrelated and sponsored/promoted pins excluded)
misinfo_definition: 'Content was compared with the International Urogynecological Association (IUGA)/International Continence Society (ICS) joint report guidelines for discussing and managing POP. The presence of misinformation was evaluated using a 1 to 5 scale, ranging from no misinformation to high levels of misinformation'

reported_quantity: % of Amazon Alexa responses to HPV vaccine queries containing at least one instance of misinformation
denominator: 6 analysable Alexa responses (Alexa provided only one oral result per query)
misinfo_definition: We defined misinformation as either deliberate or accidental promotion of previously disproved or unproven beliefs, attitudes, and behaviors.

reported_quantity: % of respondents who had heard the left-leaning conspiracy theory who reported learning it from interpersonal social networks
denominator: Respondents who had heard the left-leaning conspiracy theory (53% of the 2,765-person sample; unweighted n = 1,348)
misinfo_definition: "conspiracy theories—that is, attempts to explain the causes of events through secret plots by powerful actors"

reported_quantity: % of the top 20 news sites shared by conservative subreddits that NewsGuard says 'severely violate basic journalistic standards'
denominator: the 20 most-posted news sites in the 6 conservative subreddits
misinfo_definition: Sites in “the NewsGuardTech’s database of sites ﬂagged for COVID-19 misinformation”, whose “ﬂagged content includ[es] myths such as that Sars-Cov-2 was stolen by Chinese spies from a Canadian lab, that 5G technology is linked to the spread of COVID-19”; source credibility separately from MediaBiasFactCheck factual ratings (very low to very high) and NewsGuard trust scores

reported_quantity: % of COVID-19 data-visualisation tweets whose text opposes conventional COVID-19 measures that contain at least one reasoning error (the paper's definition of a misleading tweet)
denominator: 954 English-language original tweets containing a COVID-19 data visualisation whose text opposes conventional measures (masks, lockdowns, vaccination) or denies the existence or severity of the crisis, out of 9,958 manually coded COVID-19 visualisation tweets
misinfo_definition: visualizations that the public uses as the basis of opinionated conclusions that are entirely incorrect or contain significant reasoning errors

reported_quantity: % of surveyed breast cancer patients who reported hearing about factors purported to INCREASE risk of progression or recurrence
denominator: 997 US adults with a breast cancer diagnosis within the past 10 years who completed the survey (Breastcancer.org online sample)
misinfo_definition: Medical misinformation is information that is inaccurate or misleading according to the best available evidence.

reported_quantity: % of Pinterest cancer-recipe pins directly claiming that food- or diet-based therapies are a viable or preferable alternative to conventional cancer treatment
denominator: 103 unique Pinterest pins (post plus linked landing page) returned by the searches 'cancer recipe' and 'recipe for cancer', after duplicate removal
misinfo_definition: "online recipes, diet, and nutrition content are unregulated and may be confusing or even misleading"; the paper's framing is that "nutrition-related cancer prevention, treatment, and cure claims are prevalent in Pinterest content" and that following diet-based alternatives to conventional treatment raises mortality

reported_quantity: % of government resources on BC drug decriminalization that contained misinformation
denominator: 98 government resources on BC's decriminalization policy (52% from provincial health authority websites, 33% BC provincial government, 15% Canadian federal government), retained from 969 records identified
misinfo_definition: "Misinformation refers to false or inaccurate information that is shared without the deliberate intention of misleading readers, whereas misleading content is factually accurate information that is presented in a manner that creates confusion or distorts the surrounding context"

reported_quantity: % of the 20 most-engaged online articles about SB-201 rated inaccurate (the strict category: 90% or more of statements unsupported)
denominator: 20 unique articles: the top 10 by social engagement in each of two time windows
misinfo_definition: "Misinformation in the media can be harmful to patients and the general public"; operationalised as factual accuracy judged against "scientific information available in the peer-reviewed medical literature" and the text of SB-201

reported_quantity: % of respondents who had heard the right-leaning conspiracy theory who reported hearing it from interpersonal social networks
denominator: Respondents who had heard the right-leaning conspiracy theory (41% of the 2,765-person sample; unweighted n = 1,081)
misinfo_definition: "conspiracy theories—that is, attempts to explain the causes of events through secret plots by powerful actors"

reported_quantity: % of students who chose 'Agree' (the modal category) for 'There are misleading information about COVID-19 on social media'
denominator: 108 students of Federal Polytechnic Mubi and Adamawa State Polytechnic responding to a Google Forms questionnaire distributed via WhatsApp and Facebook
misinfo_definition: 'Fake news can simply be referred to as a modern form of propaganda'; the paper also lists the Nigerian COVID-19 narratives it has in mind: 'Corona is a conspiracy, exaggeration of several victims, certain concoctions can cure the disease, COVID-19 is an elitist disease, and coronavirus is spread by the 5 G network'

reported_quantity: % of survey respondents who had come across a news story they believed to be true and later realized was exaggerated, inaccurate or blatantly false
denominator: 309 UK internet users who completed an online survey (advertised via an online survey tool and snowballed from institutional mailing lists; 70.4% aged 18-25, 71% students)
misinfo_definition: the questions asked for instances where respondents had had cause to reflect on the 'truth' of a story, in line with Rubin's typology of 'humorous fakes in the form of news satire; large scale hoaxes ... and serious fabrication'

reported_quantity: % of adult social media users who perceive some or a lot of the health information they see on social media to be false or misleading
denominator: 3,841 US adults aged 18+ who use social media (Health Information National Trends Survey 6, nationally representative, survey-weighted with jackknife replicate weights)
misinfo_definition: "Misinformation is false or inaccurate information, while disinformation is intentionally disseminating false or inaccurate information."

reported_quantity: % of spider-related news articles containing one or more factual errors
denominator: 314 spider-related media reports published in Italian online newspapers 2010-2020 and referring to human-spider encounters in Italy
misinfo_definition: 'Providing the photo of a wrong species, calling a spider 'insect' or stating that a spider 'stings' rather than 'bites', are small errors that contribute to spread misinformation'

reported_quantity: % of respondents who say they have 'often' shared a news story on social media that they later found to be fake
denominator: 1,111 Chinese adults in a national online panel survey (Impression Boguan Network Technology / Sina Data Solution panel; cooperation rate 40.5%)
misinfo_definition: 'In this study, we define “fake news” as “news stories that are completely made up.”'

reported_quantity: % of gout-related YouTube videos coded as containing misleading information
denominator: 114 English-language gout videos meeting inclusion criteria, from the top 60 results for each of four search terms (240 screened)
misinfo_definition: "Since YouTube has no procedure for filtering videos before posting, viewers can also be exposed to misinformation"; operationalised as videos containing "at least one scientifically unproven information"

reported_quantity: % of migrant-worker respondents who had heard at least one of five widely-disseminated COVID-19 rumors
denominator: 1,011 low-waged male migrant workers involved in dormitory COVID-19 outbreaks in Singapore
misinfo_definition: "widely-disseminated COVID-19 rumors"; "On a global scale, these rumors have been widely disseminated and have been studied in other surveys"

reported_quantity: % of movies portraying schizophrenia that contained misinformation about schizophrenia
denominator: 41 English-language commercial movies released theatrically 1990-2010 featuring at least one main character with schizophrenia (from over 70 movies viewed)
misinfo_definition: "Critics of entertainment media have indicated that cinematic depictions of schizophrenia are stereotypic and characterized by misinformation about symptoms, causes, and treatment"

reported_quantity: % of cohort respondents who reported having seen TDF/Truvada injury-lawsuit ads on social media
denominator: 2,078 HIV-negative cisgender men, transgender men and transgender women who have sex with men in the US Together 5000 cohort who completed the month-24 assessment by March 2020 (2,204 responses minus 126 HIV-positive participants)
misinfo_definition: "these advertisements promote false information about the safety of PrEP [TDF] by suggesting that rare side-effects (e.g., renal failure and substantial bone loss) are commonplace" (quoted by the authors from a 2020 Lancet HIV commentary)

reported_quantity: % of Reddit posts linking to a news source whose domain was flagged by NewsGuard as a source of COVID-19 misinformation (all 14 subreddits pooled)
denominator: 5,258 COVID-19 posts linking to external news sources, collected from 12 politically biased subreddits and 2 neutral subreddits
misinfo_definition: Sites in “the NewsGuardTech’s database of sites ﬂagged for COVID-19 misinformation”, whose “ﬂagged content includ[es] myths such as that Sars-Cov-2 was stolen by Chinese spies from a Canadian lab, that 5G technology is linked to the spread of COVID-19”; source credibility separately from MediaBiasFactCheck factual ratings (very low to very high) and NewsGuard trust scores

reported_quantity: % of news media articles on BC drug decriminalization that contained misleading content (technically accurate but distorting)
denominator: 301 media articles on BC's decriminalization policy
misinfo_definition: "misleading content is factually accurate information that is presented in a manner that creates confusion or distorts the surrounding context"

reported_quantity: % of PFP websites whose description of the definition of patellofemoral pain was rated inaccurate/misleading against consensus statements
denominator: 40 unique websites offering information about patellofemoral pain, from the first 20 Google and Bing results for 'patellofemoral pain' and 'knee cap pain' (80 URLs, minus 30 duplicates, 6 not PFP-specific, 4 inactive)
misinfo_definition: Content rated as "(iii) Inaccurate/Misleading description" relative to "the most recent consensus statements on terminology, clinical examination and treatment from the International Patellofemoral Pain Research Network published by an expert panel of clinicians and researchers"

reported_quantity: % of analysed dental fear/anxiety/phobia YouTube videos containing misleading information
denominator: 145 English-language YouTube videos on dental fear, dental anxiety or dental phobia, drawn from the 100 most-viewed results for each of three search terms (300 screened, 181 after duplicate removal, 145 eligible)
misinfo_definition: No formal definition given; items are labelled 'misleading information' / 'Misinformation' and each is paired with a corrective statement beginning 'Truth:'.

reported_quantity: % of parents who report having seen information against HPV vaccination on social media, alone or mixed with information in favor
denominator: 1,073 U.S. parents of at least one 11- to 17-year-old child who use social media (Qualtrics national panel)
misinfo_definition: No formal definition; the paper equates social media content against HPV vaccination with vaccine misinformation: 'social media content for some health topics like vaccines may show misinformation' and 'Efforts should be sought to increase online information in favor of HPV vaccination and combat vaccine misinformation in social media.'

reported_quantity: % of respondents in latent class 5 who report having ever shared a political news story online that they thought at the time was made up (intentional sharing)
denominator: 383 Polish active Facebook news users in latent class 5 ("The youngest, heavy SM users with average SM literacy"); total sample 1,000 recruited from the largest Polish research panel
misinfo_definition: "For the purpose of this study, fake news is understood as partially or completely false information, intended to mislead the recipient, which may be intentionally and unintentionally disseminated by online news consumers"

reported_quantity: % of practitioners reporting they 'often' or 'sometimes' encountered patient misinformation about essential oils
denominator: 2,101 practitioners answering the essential-oils misinformation frequency item
misinfo_definition: 'information that is factually inaccurate or not supported by current evidence-based medical literature and/or practices'

reported_quantity: % of Italian COVID-19 YouTube comments that were posted on videos from channels labelled questionable
denominator: 1,273,930 Italian-language comments on COVID-19 YouTube videos, posted 15/01/2020-15/06/2020
misinfo_definition: "A channel was labeled as questionable if it regularly produced unverified or false content, or was affiliated with news outlets that had repeatedly failed fact-checks conducted by independent organizations."

reported_quantity: % of deepfake-aware US survey respondents who say they have ever shared a deepfake without realising it was fake
denominator: 764 US online panel respondents (Qualtrics, quota-matched on age and gender) who reported being aware of deepfakes before the survey, out of 1,244 collected
misinfo_definition: "Deepfakes use machine-learning algorithms to create video and audio of real people doing and saying untrue things."

reported_quantity: % of genitourinary-cancer TikTok videos containing obvious misinformation
denominator: 61 sample videos on bladder, prostate and kidney cancer retained after exclusions from 167 retrieved TikTok videos
misinfo_definition: "Numbers of obvious misinformation or ambiguous knowledge points on each video were recorded, and types of misinformation would be categorized"; the leading type is "the quotation of outdated data and content", judged against real-world clinical practice

reported_quantity: % of fact-checked claims about the Russo-Ukrainian conflict rated 'False' (demonstrably false) by Snopes
denominator: 128 Snopes fact-checking reports on the Russo-Ukrainian conflict published 24 February 2022 - 28 June 2023
misinfo_definition: "False. The primary elements of a claim are demonstrably false."

reported_quantity: % of respondents who indicated they often encountered news and information containing misleading content
denominator: 410 US adults aged 18-75 recruited via Amazon MTurk (448 participated, 38 excluded for incompletion/missing critical answers)
misinfo_definition: "Often defined as false or inaccurate information, misinformation could inflame social conflicts, decrease institutional trust, precipitate public health crises, and inflict economic damage."
